cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)
project(cui_date_time_worker C CXX)
set(CMAKE_C_STANDARD 11)
set(CMAKE_C_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
set(CMAKE_C_EXTENSIONS OFF)
enable_testing()
get_filename_component(CUI_SOURCE_DIR "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../../.." ABSOLUTE)
set(CUI_BUILD_NATIVE OFF CACHE BOOL "Portable worker fixture" FORCE)
option(CUI_DATETIME_BUILD_STYLED "Include optional Styled facade" ON)
add_subdirectory("${CUI_SOURCE_DIR}" cui EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL)
if(NOT CUI_DATETIME_BUILD_STYLED)
 get_target_property(sources cui SOURCES)
 list(FILTER sources EXCLUDE REGEX "src/components/cui_date_time_picker.c$")
 set_property(TARGET cui PROPERTY SOURCES "${sources}")
endif()
